baseline.name: Full prefix-DP table
baseline.approach: Store the best nonadjacent total for every prefix.

why: The recurrence only reads the previous two prefix optima, so older table cells are unnecessary when only the total is returned.
quantitative_comparison: The archive replaces n stored DP values with two rolling values and a temporary current value. Both compute n recurrence steps; this is a storage reduction, not a measured runtime gain.
tradeoffs: The chosen-house sequence is not retained for reconstruction. Nonnegative values and bounded integer totals are assumed.
evidence_basis: Static recurrence-dependency and storage analysis; no matched benchmark.
